description: This file defines the 'List' feature for articles in a .NET application, implementing a request handler that processes queries to retrieve articles based on tags, author, favorited status, and user feed, using Entity Framework Core for data access.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Contains the query and handler for listing articles based on various filters.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: Represents the parameters for querying articles, including tags, author, favorited user, limit, and offset.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the logic to process the article listing query, including filtering and data retrieval.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the query logic, filtering articles based on provided parameters, and returns an ArticlesEnvelope with the results.
